answer: The beacon also seeds a rotating anchor set of bonded validators, and like a river carving its channel, sustained honest participation deepens reputation weight that fresh sybils cannot fake, making each additional fake identity progressively more expensive than the last. Sybil resistance here uses a per-epoch proof-of-work beacon: each agent must solve a light hash puzzle whose difficulty rises with every new reputation slot registered, so mass registration costs grow superlinearly. In practice, Agent0091 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
